name: Gravity House Duology
storyline: First, examine the tense, dangerous double-bind between a cynical social media figure and a runaway in, "Prisoners in the Mirror," co-written by Joyce Fisher and Ophelia C. Green. Then, venture into the far, far future and experience the final chapter of life as we know it in, "Colony-Organism: Microbes of Love and Pain," written by Ophelia C. Green.
summary: A collection of two short stories by the art collective Gravity House.
